description.value: Zanatta Estate Winery holds the distinction of being Vancouver Island's first estate winery, farming 25 acres in the Glenora area of the Cowichan Valley for over half a century. The family-run operation specializes in Champagne-style sparkling wines made entirely from estate-grown fruit across sparkling, white, rosé, and red styles. Cyclists can linger on the verandah with a glass, join wine club events, or pick up bottles to bring home from this heritage stop in a region celebrated for cycle touring.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Zanatta Estate Winery is Vancouver Island's first estate winery, operating in Glenora near Duncan with 25 acres of estate-grown grapes; the 2026 season opened May 1st confirming it is currently open. OSM tags (address, phone, website) are all corroborated by the website content. No website content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenity, so all those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Duncan' but the winery is physically in Glenora, approximately 10 minutes from downtown Duncan — the street address is correct but the community label may mislead directory users.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website; a field visit or direct contact is needed to confirm these for full WWC accreditation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Zanatta is a legitimate, actively operating heritage winery in the Cowichan Valley, one of BC's premier cycling destinations; touring cyclists would benefit from knowing this distinctive stop exists, pending field confirmation of basic amenities.
